layouts.name: Centered hero
layouts.hint: Headline and button centered at the top. Simple and focused.
layouts.brief: Centered hero: headline, sub-text and CTA stacked and centered, a wide visual below; sections follow in a symmetric, centered rhythm.

layouts.name: Split hero (text + visual)
layouts.hint: Text on one side, an image or product on the other. The most common landing layout.
layouts.brief: Split hero: copy and CTAs in the left ~half, a product visual on the right; sections alternate between full-width grids and left/right splits.

layouts.name: Product-screenshot-led
layouts.hint: A short headline, then a big product screenshot. Shows the product immediately.
layouts.brief: Product-screenshot-led: compact centered headline and CTA, then a very large framed product screenshot that dominates the first screen; features reference parts of the screenshot.

layouts.name: Bento grid
layouts.hint: Features arranged as a mosaic of different-sized tiles. Modern and scannable.
layouts.brief: Bento grid: a split or centered hero, then features shown as a mosaic of unequal tiles (one large hero tile, mixed 2x1 and 1x1 tiles) with visuals inside the tiles.

layouts.name: Long-form story
layouts.hint: A scrolling story: each section explains one idea with text and a picture side by side.
layouts.brief: Long-form story: a strong narrative hero, then features as alternating full-width text/visual rows (zig-zag), each telling one step of the story; generous vertical rhythm.

layouts.name: Sidebar + card grid
layouts.hint: Navigation on the left, information in cards on the right. The classic app dashboard.
layouts.brief: App shell with a persistent left sidebar navigation and a top bar; the main area is a responsive grid of cards (KPIs, chart, table). Sidebar collapses to a drawer on mobile.

layouts.name: Top nav + wide tables
layouts.hint: Navigation across the top and full-width tables. Best when there's a lot of data to compare.
layouts.brief: Top navigation bar with tabs, a filter bar, then wide full-width data tables and charts; optimized for scanning rows of data.

layouts.name: List / detail split
layouts.hint: A list on the left; clicking an item shows its details on the right. Like an email app.
layouts.brief: Two-pane list/detail: a scrollable list of items on the left (~1/3), the selected item's details, KPIs and chart on the right (~2/3). On mobile the panes stack.

layouts.name: Three-tier cards
layouts.hint: Three plan cards side by side with the recommended one highlighted.
layouts.brief: Three plan cards in a row with the middle plan visually emphasized, a monthly/yearly toggle above, then a detailed comparison table and FAQ.

layouts.name: Comparison-table-led
layouts.hint: A big feature-by-feature table. Best when plans differ in many details.
layouts.brief: Compact plan summary row followed by a large sticky-header comparison table grouped by feature category.

layouts.name: Centered card
layouts.hint: A single form card in the middle of the page. Focused and familiar.
layouts.brief: A single centered auth card with logo, heading, social sign-in buttons, divider, email/password fields and a primary button.

layouts.name: Split: form + brand panel
layouts.hint: Form on one side, a branded panel with a quote or visual on the other.
layouts.brief: Two-column auth page: form on the left half, a branded panel on the right with a testimonial or product visual; the panel hides on mobile.

layouts.name: Classic reading column
layouts.hint: One comfortable column of text, like a good book.
layouts.brief: Single centered reading column (~68ch) with a large title, byline, lead image, well-set prose, pull quotes and code blocks.

layouts.name: Article + table of contents
layouts.hint: Text with a sticky table of contents on the side. Good for long technical posts.
layouts.brief: Article body with a sticky table of contents in a side column on desktop; the TOC collapses into a disclosure on mobile.

layouts.name: Grid gallery
layouts.hint: Work shown as a grid of images first, words second.
layouts.brief: Short intro, then a dense image grid of projects with hover captions; about and contact below.

layouts.name: Big intro
layouts.hint: A large personal statement up top, then selected work.
layouts.brief: Oversized typographic personal statement filling the first screen, then a list of case studies with large thumbnails.
